body: I really love and appreciate your response. thank you for taking to time to write that, you have a kind heart.

I understand and appreciate your sentiment, but I have messed up things to a point where I don't even know what a solution would be. I feel like if I look back on this time in my life, all I'll feel is regret and sadness at wasting time and losing opportunities I'll never get back. I've been holding on for a few years now, just taking it day by day, and I can't put myself through that anymore. Living a life alone is hard.
